hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM using Euler vaults as liquidity sources. In beforeSwap, it intercepts all swaps, computes quotes via a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), takes input tokens into Euler vault deposits, and pays output tokens from vault withdrawals — settling fully via beforeSwapReturnsDelta without touching the standard concentrated liquidity pool.
